steps.name: sd-storage-root-cause-audit
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=e744e1fdf430ac35165f61a21f4c4b7fbf8a7e4f; git fetch -q origin mvp/environment-controller; git reset --hard $EXPECTED >/dev/null; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/mvp/environment-controller)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo '[AUDIT] repo/head'; git remote get-url origin; git rev-parse HEAD; echo '[AUDIT] storage paths and durability calls'; grep -RInE 'GBLOG|beginSession|appendLine|fflush|fsync|f_sync|fclose|Stage27TelemetryLogger' src scripts test CMakeLists.txt 2>/dev/null | head -n 500; echo '[AUDIT] service console integration'; grep -RInE 'Stage28ServiceConsole|parseStage28ServiceConsoleCommand|service.*status|uart|USB_SERIAL|USB_CDC|console' src scripts test CMakeLists.txt 2>/dev/null | head -n 500; echo '[AUDIT] relevant tests/targets'; grep -RInE 'stage27.*storage|stage27.*telemetry.*logger|stage28.*service.*console' test CMakeLists.txt 2>/dev/null | head -n 300; echo '[AUDIT] ESP-IDF fsync bridge'; if command -v idf.py >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -n "${IDF_PATH:-}" ]; then grep -RInE 'fsync.*f_sync|f_sync.*fsync|_fsync_r' "$IDF_PATH/components/fatfs" "$IDF_PATH/components/vfs" 2>/dev/null | head -n 100 || true; fi; echo '[AUDIT] focused host configure'; rm -rf build/host-sd-audit-v1; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-sd-audit-v1 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug >/tmp/sd-audit-cmake.log; cmake --build build/host-sd-audit-v1 --target help | grep -Ei 'stage27.*(storage|telemetry)|stage28.*service' | head -n 100 || true; git diff --check; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo SD_STORAGE_AUDIT_V1_COMPLETE
